title: ammannia involucrata
intro: Ammannia involucrata, commonly known as Swampweed, is a plant species in the Lythraceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Ammannia involucrata include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory function, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
